description: Confirm an AI call after reviewing push-back questions, optionally providing answers to missing info. Required when ai_call returns state='pending_confirm'. Uses the original payment — no new payment needed. Returns call_id for polling with check_job_status(jobType='ai-call').

answers.description: Key-value answers to the push-back questions (keys are the question strings, values are your answers). Omit to confirm the task as-is.

sessionId.description: Session ID from the ai_call response

name: confirm_ai_call
